title: Lawyer / Legal Associate job
raw_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Lawyer / Legal Associate
Full-Time | Law Firm / Corporate Legal Team
Experience: 2+ Years    Practice Areas: Civil, Contract, and Corporate Law
Job Summary
We are seeking a responsible and detail-oriented Lawyer / Legal Associate to support legal research, prepare
and review legal documents, assist with case management, and advise clients or internal teams on legal
matters. The ideal candidate should have strong legal reasoning, clear written and verbal communication, and
the ability to manage multiple matters while maintaining confidentiality and professional ethics.
Key Responsibilities
•
Conduct legal research and analyze statutes, rules, regulations, judgments, and case law relevant to assigned
matters.
•
Draft, review, and proofread contracts, legal notices, petitions, pleadings, affidavits, opinions, and other legal
documents as appropriate to the role.
•
Assist in preparing cases, maintaining case files, tracking deadlines, and organizing supporting evidence and
documentation.
•
Support client consultations, gather relevant facts, and explain legal procedures and options in clear language.
•
Assist with court filings, hearings, negotiations, dispute resolution, and coordination with external counsel where
required.
•
Review agreements and identify legal risks, unclear clauses, and compliance concerns.
•
Maintain accurate records of matters, correspondence, research, and case progress.
•
Protect confidential client information and follow applicable professional conduct requirements.
•
Monitor relevant legal and regulatory updates and communicate their impact to the team.
Must-Have Requirements
•
Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) from a recognized institution.
•
At least 2 years of relevant legal experience in a law firm, legal department, or comparable practice.
•
Strong legal research, analysis, drafting, and document-review skills.
•
Working knowledge of applicable laws, court procedures, and legal documentation relevant to assigned matters.
•
Clear written and verbal communication, client-handling, and negotiation skills.
•
Strong attention to detail, organization, and deadline management.
•
Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and professionalism.
•
For roles involving court appearances or legal practice in India, the appropriate enrollment and practice eligibility
must be met.
Nice-to-Have Requirements
•
Experience with contract management, corporate compliance, or litigation support.
•
Familiarity with legal research databases and digital case-management tools.
•
Experience preparing case summaries, legal opinions, due-diligence notes, or risk assessments.
•
Knowledge of alternative dispute resolution, including mediation or arbitration.
•
Comfort using document-management software and standard office productivity tools.

Educational and Professional Qualifications
LL.B. is required. An LL.M. or focused training in corporate law, contracts, litigation, intellectual property,
employment law, or another relevant practice area is an advantage. Any jurisdiction-specific license, enrollment,
or eligibility requirements must be satisfied for the duties assigned.
Core Skills
Legal: Legal research, statutory interpretation, case-law analysis, drafting, contract review, litigation support,
compliance awareness, and case documentation.
Professional: Critical thinking, negotiation, communication, confidentiality, ethical judgment, time management,
and client service.
Selection Process
•
Resume and experience review.
•
Legal research and drafting exercise.
•
Discussion of relevant cases or practical scenarios.
•
Technical interview with the legal team.
•
Final discussion on role expectations and professional eligibility.
Success Criteria
The successful candidate will produce accurate and well-organized legal work, identify relevant legal issues and
risks, meet matter deadlines, communicate clearly with clients and colleagues, and maintain professional
confidentiality and ethical standards.
